# Requirements Review Checklist: Exercise Library

**Purpose**: Validate the completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of Exercise Library requirements before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are browse, search, filtering, detail, favorites, and custom exercise CRUD requirements all explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §User Stories 1–4]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are every required exercise field and its required or optional status specified consistently? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007/FR-010/FR-001A]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are the fixed muscle, equipment, and difficulty taxonomy values fully documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002/FR-005A]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are loading, empty, error, retry, and save-failure requirements defined for every library workflow? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are authentication requirements specified for browse, detail, favorites, and custom exercise mutations? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008/FR-010/Plan §REST Endpoints]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are success and failure outcomes specified for each primary custom exercise action? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 4]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are out-of-scope workout plans, logging, rotation, history, analytics, and sharing boundaries documented sufficiently to prevent scope creep? [Completeness, Spec §Out of Scope]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK008 - Is case-insensitive partial-name search behavior explicitly and unambiguously defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the distinction between OR behavior within filter categories and AND behavior across categories explicit enough to be implemented without interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK010 - Are the fixed equipment taxonomy values identifiable rather than left only as an implementation decision? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-005A]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are positive numeric set and rep requirements quantified with integer and range constraints? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is `valid image/demo reference` defined with accepted formats or source constraints? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001A]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is the privacy-safe response for another user's custom exercise detail or mutation clearly distinguished as 404 or 403? [Clarity, Plan §REST Endpoints]
- [ ] CHK014 - Is the meaning of a reset-filter action specified sufficiently to preserve or clear search, filter, and Favorites state consistently? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 - Do browse, detail, edit, delete, and search requirements consistently restrict custom exercises to their owner? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012/FR-013/FR-015]
- [ ] CHK016 - Do predefined exercise requirements remain consistent across read-only browse, detail, edit, and delete scenarios? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001/FR-014/FR-022]
- [ ] CHK017 - Are custom exercise media requirements consistent between creation, editing, detail, and fallback behavior? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications/FR-010/FR-001A]
- [ ] CHK018 - Do the success criteria align with the primary user stories and acceptance scenarios rather than adding unrelated outcomes? [Consistency, Spec §User Stories/Measurable Outcomes]
- [ ] CHK019 - Is favorite behavior consistent for predefined and owned custom exercises across add, remove, browse, and delete flows? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008/FR-009]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK020 - Can the 95% task-completion targets be objectively measured with a defined test population and task protocol? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001/SC-002/SC-003]
- [ ] CHK021 - Is the 2-second search/filter target measurable under a documented network, device, and 1,000-exercise test setup? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK022 - Can the 320 px and 1920 px responsive requirements be objectively checked for overflow and blocked controls? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK023 - Is WCAG 2.1 AA compliance scope defined across all exercise states and interactive components? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-003]
- [ ] CHK024 - Is 100% privacy and predefined-read-only enforcement supported by a sufficiently complete acceptance scenario set? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004/SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK025 - Are requirements defined for a user with no custom exercises, no favorites, and no matching search results? [Coverage, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK026 - Are requirements defined for a custom exercise sharing the same name as a predefined or another user's exercise? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 - Are recovery requirements defined for network loss or save failure while custom exercise draft data exists? [Recovery, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are requirements defined for an exercise becoming unavailable or deleted while a user is viewing, favoriting, editing, or browsing it? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK029 - Are requirements defined for concurrent favorite add/remove actions or repeated submission? [Concurrency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are requirements defined for ownership-changing or deleted custom exercise data in cached client views? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-021]

## Edge Case & Error Requirements

- [ ] CHK031 - Are whitespace-only search terms specified to produce a documented empty or neutral search behavior? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are invalid taxonomy, missing required fields, invalid sets/reps, and malformed media values all mapped to field-specific requirements? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are predefined seeded media-reference failures specified to prevent invalid records from entering the library? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are custom exercise media omissions defined to produce a consistent unavailable-media detail state? [Edge Case, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are API status-code choices defined for unauthenticated, forbidden, missing, validation, and unexpected-failure scenarios? [Completeness, Spec §Plan §Error Handling]
- [ ] CHK036 - Is the standard API error envelope and field-level detail format specified for every validation failure? [Clarity, Plan §Error Handling]

## Security & Privacy Requirements

- [ ] CHK037 - Are authentication requirements specified for every Exercise Library endpoint rather than only mutation endpoints? [Security, Gap]
- [ ] CHK038 - Are custom exercise visibility and detail-access rules consistently defined to prevent cross-user discovery? [Security, Spec §FR-015/NFR-005]
- [ ] CHK039 - Are authorization rules for owner-only edit/delete independently explicit from authentication rules? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012/FR-013]
- [ ] CHK040 - Are secrets, database credentials, and authentication configuration prohibited from source and test fixtures? [Security, Constitution §IV]
- [ ] CHK041 - Are favorite records privacy-scoped and isolated from all other users in the requirement set? [Security, Spec §FR-009]

## Accessibility & UX Requirements

- [ ] CHK042 - Are keyboard operability requirements specified for search, filters, favorites, detail, and custom exercise forms? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK043 - Are visible labels and screen-reader feedback requirements defined for filter, favorite, validation, and save-state changes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK044 - Are focus, contrast, semantic structure, and dark/light theme requirements measurable across every required viewport? [Clarity, Spec §NFR-002/NFR-003]
- [ ] CHK045 - Is the responsive breakpoint behavior specified beyond the minimum 320 px and maximum 1920 px endpoints? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK046 - Are unavailable-media and no-results states specified to remain understandable and keyboard-operable? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases/FR-020]

## Data Integrity & Traceability

- [ ] CHK047 - Are predefined exercise metadata update and deletion restrictions explicit enough to prevent seed-record mutation by custom exercise actions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK048 - Are custom exercise deletion requirements explicit about favorite cleanup without mutating unrelated historical records? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK049 - Is the relationship between Exercise, muscle taxonomy, and Favorite entities complete and free of ambiguous cardinality? [Clarity, Spec §Key Entities]
- [ ] CHK050 - Are every custom exercise and favorite record tied to the correct owning user in the requirement model? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009/FR-015]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK051 - Is the dependency on an existing authenticated-user mechanism documented with the required identity fields and authorization behavior? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK052 - Are the controlled equipment values defined from a maintained source rather than an unspecified `fixed` taxonomy? [Dependency, Ambiguity]
- [ ] CHK053 - Is the seeded predefined-exercise dependency and its read-only media/metadata validation source documented? [Dependency, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK054 - Is the persistent theme-preference dependency defined consistently for authenticated users? [Dependency, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK055 - Are pagination or virtualization requirements defined clearly enough to satisfy 1,000-exercise performance without overloading mobile clients? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions/NFR-001]

## Constitution Alignment

- [ ] CHK056 - Do requirements preserve the exercise-configuration versus workout-history separation required by the constitution? [Traceability, Constitution §I]
- [ ] CHK057 - Do requirements avoid introducing weekdays, rotation, logging, or analytics into the Exercise Library scope? [Consistency, Constitution §IV/Spec §Out of Scope]
- [ ] CHK058 - Are modular React, Express, relational persistence, REST, validation, and test requirements aligned without conflicting architectural choices? [Consistency, Constitution §Architecture]
- [ ] CHK059 - Are definition-of-done requirements complete for input validation, error handling, loading/empty states, and critical tests? [Completeness, Constitution §V]
- [ ] CHK060 - Does every new domain feature integration test requirement explicitly cover privacy and template/history separation? [Traceability, Constitution §V]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` is a separate built-in checklist maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Link to relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
